name: Robinson R66
summary: Robinson's five-seat turbine helicopter, built on an enlarged R44-style airframe with a Rolls-Royce RR300 engine.

wings: Two-blade teetering main rotor on a tall mast with a larger, taller mast fairing than the R44
engines: Single turbine fully enclosed in a tall cowling behind the cabin
Turbine exhaust stack pointing up and aft at the back of the cowling
fuselage: R44-like bubble cabin with two doors per side, but slightly larger
Separate baggage compartment door on the side behind the rear passenger door
tail: Two-blade tail rotor with upper and lower fins and a horizontal stabilizer

tellTales: Tall, fully enclosed engine cowling with an exhaust stack, behind a small bubble cabin
Small baggage door on the side between cabin and tail boom
Two-blade rotor on a tall mast with a bulky fairing

confusedWith.howToTell: The R66 has a tall enclosed turbine cowling, an exhaust stack and a rear baggage door; the R44 has a lower piston engine bay and no exhaust stack.
The JetRanger has a stockier cabin, a short thick mast and endplate fins on its horizontal stabilizer; the R66 has Robinson's tall slender mast and tubular boom.
